title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26; battery output below zero is charging
source_line: Source: CAISO, EIA via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_battery_storage, eia930_ciso_demand; data retrieved to 2026-09-28.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). todays_outlook_storage: Today's Outlook: batteries trend (storage.csv history). https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/supply. via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table caiso_battery_storage, data commit 2c667859235e.

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). electricity/rto/region-data: Form EIA-930, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor: hourly demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and interchange by balancing authority. https://www.eia.gov/electricity/gridmonitor/. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table eia930_ciso_demand, data commit 2c667859235e.
facts: CAISO, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 17:00 Pacific at 33513.57 MW, when batteries delivered a mean 2243.13 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 19:00, 8186.45 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 11:00, -8568.75 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27: 6195.87 MW.
